subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the exact refreshed head be approved as one grouped update after direct Codex contract review and green security/workflow gates, or should the credential-bearing Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and Docker updates be reviewed separately?
rationale: These upstream actions run with secrets or elevated repository capabilities, and repository policy assigns explicit security ownership; the missing direct sibling-Codex inspection prevents automation from safely making the final boundary judgment.

options.title: Approve after targeted review
options.body: Keep the grouped immutable-pin update, but require a refreshed head, direct Codex CLI contract inspection, secops approval, and green exact-head workflow gates.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and Docker credential-bearing actions into smaller PRs so each upstream behavioral delta can be reviewed and proven independently.

options.title: Pause this refresh
options.body: Close or defer this grouped update and allow Dependabot to regenerate it when maintainers have capacity for the security-boundary review.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted review
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped immutable-pin update, but require a refreshed head, direct Codex CLI contract inspection, secops approval, and green exact-head workflow gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal combines CodeQL security workflow ownership with Docker and Blacksmith CI work.
